# Funded round for task 3 (Validate frame), stopped at turn end

## 1. Decode the funding

- The header `**Amend-grant:** fund 1 fix rounds` sets N = 1.
- Task 3's per-task ledger has spent = 0, so one funded round is available.
- The convergence exception is not re-armed, and funding does not add another escalation.
- The ordinary loop and the escalated round are already used up. The escalated CR re-review came back issue-bearing (DIVERGING), so the funded round is next.

Printed before dispatch:

```
funded round 1 of 1 for task 3
```

## 2. Funded fix dispatch

This repeats the escalated round's payload and isolation exactly. It is one in-place implementer in the branch checkout. There is no `worktree: true` and no fan-out, because the integrated wave is not yet committed.

```ts
subagent({
  agent: "implementer",
  model: "<configured-impl-model>",   // gauntlet_setting({ key: "escalationLoop" }).implModel
  context: "fresh",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `<task 3 "Validate frame" full text verbatim>
<Leg:/Rules: context if any, per Leg routing>
Spec: <absolute spec path> + task 3 Spec: anchors verbatim
Prior patch: <the escalated round's patch / current integrated state in /workspace/project>
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS:
node --test frame.test.mjs
TEST_CONTRACT: <task 3 Tests: block verbatim + Files: Create:/Test: paths>

## Previous review report (re-review trigger)
<complete escalated-round CR re-review report verbatim:
 Verdict: FIX_FIRST ... src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard ...
 Behaviour-change: no
 TRAJECTORY: DIVERGING (3 -> 3, max severity Moderate)>

Do not commit or stage.
**Status:** DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | BLOCKED | NEEDS_CONTEXT  <status protocol verbatim>`
})
```

- Fixed observation: the implementer returns `DONE` with a nonempty tracked delta.
- The ledger for task 3 is now spent = 1 of 1.

## 3. Scoped test gate (parent)

```bash
(cd "/workspace/project" && node --test frame.test.mjs)
```

Fixed observation: the command passes.

## 4. Stage and record the Fix-delta tree

Stage all deliverables:

```bash
git -C /workspace/project add -A
```

Then record the review tree with the fix-delta block:

```bash
FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'
FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
FD_STATUS=$?
rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
exit "$FD_STATUS"
```

- The printed SHA becomes `<tree-after>`, keyed to this wave for CR.
- `<tree-before>` is the tree recorded when the escalated CR re-review was dispatched.

Produce the delta:

```bash
git -C /workspace/project diff --binary <tree-before> <tree-after>
```

The delta is nonempty, so the re-review proceeds.

## 5. CR re-review

`Behaviour-change: no` means this is a CR-only re-review.

```ts
subagent({
  agent: "code-reviewer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `<filled ../requesting-code-review/code-reviewer.md>
DESCRIPTION: wave summary for task 3 "Validate frame" + funded fix summary
PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS: task 3 text from the plan
BASE_SHA: <WAVE_BASE_SHA>
HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS:
node --test frame.test.mjs

## Previous review report (re-review trigger)
<escalated-round CR re-review report verbatim>

<trajectory block from code-quality-reviewer-prompt.md "Re-review: trajectory verdict" verbatim>

## Fix delta
<output of git diff --binary <tree-before> <tree-after>>`
})
```

Fixed observation: `FIX_FIRST`, `TRAJECTORY: DIVERGING (3 -> 3, max severity Moderate)`, with the same finding `src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard`.

## 6. Route the result

- The funded re-review is issue-bearing after N = 1 rounds, so the parent stops with task 3's stop note.
- No fix round 2 is dispatched, and there is no second escalation.
- There is no wave commit and no `reset --soft`.
- Task 3 stays `in_progress`, and there is no `plan_tracker` write.
- The phase stays `implement`.

```
gauntlet: question
Stopped on task 3 (Validate frame); escalated round on <configured-impl-model> did not resolve it.

Problem: frame validation still lacks a length guard at src/frame.ts:21, so frames of insufficient length are not rejected before being read; the final code review still blocks on it.
budget: 1 of 1 spent
  src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard

Fix options:
  a) add an explicit length check at src/frame.ts:21 that rejects a frame shorter than the length the validator reads, before any field access
  b) amend plan task 3 / its spec anchor to state the exact minimum-length rule and rejection behaviour, then re-run the task against it
  c) write a new budget token (e.g. `**Amend-grant:** fund 1 fix rounds`) to fund another round on the current approach

Pick one, or give another fix.
```

The turn ends here.

The escalation has already been used. The header funds exactly one additional round; none has been spent. Dispatch that round in place, then re-review with CR only because `Behaviour-change: no`. Keep task 3 `in_progress`; do not commit.

Below, `«…verbatim…»` denotes insertion of the available text, not a summary or invented report.

### 1. Funded repair

Print before dispatch:

```text
funded round 1 of 1 for task 3
```

```js
subagent({
  agent: "implementer",
  model: "<configured-impl-model>",
  context: "fresh",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `
You are repairing task 3: Validate frame, in the existing integrated wave.

«original task text verbatim»
«spec anchors and applicable rules verbatim»
«status protocol verbatim»

Read the referenced spec anchors and applicable rules before acting.
Repair the review findings in place.

SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS:
node --test frame.test.mjs

TEST_CONTRACT:
«original Tests block and Test paths verbatim»

«same repair context and payload used for the escalated fix, verbatim»

## Previous review report
«complete escalated CR re-review report verbatim, including:
FIX_FIRST, Behaviour-change: no,
TRAJECTORY: DIVERGING (3 -> 3, max severity Moderate),
and src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard»

Return an explicit DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, NEEDS_CONTEXT, or BLOCKED status.
`
})
```

This is a plain in-place worker: no `worktree: true`, no fan-out, and no commit or staging instruction to the implementer.

### 2. Parent scoped gate and review preparation

After the stipulated `DONE` result, run:

```bash
(cd "/workspace/project" && node --test frame.test.mjs)
```

After that passes:

```bash
git -C "/workspace/project" add -A
```

Record the current review tree with the complete scratch-index block:

```bash
FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'
FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
FD_STATUS=$?
rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
exit "$FD_STATUS"
```

Record the printed SHA as task 3’s funded CR review tree. Using the actual recorded tree SHAs—not commit SHAs—produce the fix delta:

```bash
git -C "/workspace/project" diff --binary \
  '<tree recorded at escalated CR re-review dispatch>' \
  '<tree printed above>'
```

The scenario stipulates a nonempty tracked delta. Include that complete output in the next payload.

### 3. Funded CR re-review

The review source remains the integrated wave: recorded `WAVE_BASE_SHA` against `WORKTREE`. The fix delta supplements that source; it does not replace it.

```js
subagent({
  agent: "code-reviewer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  output: "/tmp/task3-funded-cr.md",
  task: `
Use the code-quality reviewer template and read-only review boundaries.

«implementation and repair summaries verbatim»

PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS:
«original task text, spec anchors, and applicable rules verbatim»

BASE_SHA: «recorded WAVE_BASE_SHA»
HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE

SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS:
node --test frame.test.mjs

Review the complete staged and unstaged integrated wave diff against BASE_SHA.
Assess production readiness. Do not edit files.

## Previous review report (re-review trigger)
«complete escalated CR re-review report verbatim»

## Fix delta
«complete git diff --binary output between the two recorded review trees»

If your task contains a "Previous review report (re-review trigger)" section
and you found issues, append exactly one more line after Behaviour-change:

TRAJECTORY: CONVERGING (<n_prev> -> <n_now>, max severity <X>)
TRAJECTORY: DIVERGING
TRAJECTORY: STAGNANT (repeat of: <finding>)

Choose STAGNANT first if a previous Critical or Moderate finding survives
materially unchanged; otherwise DIVERGING if the count did not decrease or
a new Critical or Moderate appeared; otherwise CONVERGING.
Count only Critical and Moderate findings. If clean, omit TRAJECTORY.
`
})
```

Read the saved terminal report:

```bash
cat "/tmp/task3-funded-cr.md"
```

Under the supplied fixed observation, it remains `FIX_FIRST` with `TRAJECTORY: DIVERGING (3 -> 3, max severity Moderate)` and the length-guard finding. The sole funded round is exhausted. Dispatch nothing further, make no wave commit, and leave task 3 `in_progress`.
